high_level_description: This image features a white cat with brown and black markings lying on its back on a concrete surface near the edge of a body of water, likely an ocean or sea. The cat appears relaxed and is stretching one of its front paws upwards, while the other front paw is bent at the elbow. Its hind legs are extended outwards, and it seems to be enjoying a moment of leisure. The background shows a vast expanse of water meeting the horizon under a partly cloudy sky. The clouds are scattered, allowing patches of blue sky to be visible, suggesting a calm and pleasant day.
